I fixed the bug in `invoicing/currency.py`, and all 8 tests now pass, including `test_invoice_jpy`.

The cause was in `minor_units`: it lowercased the currency code (`"jpy"`) before checking it against `ZERO_DECIMAL`, but that set stores codes in uppercase (`{"JPY", "KRW"}`). The check never matched, so JPY and KRW were treated as having two decimal places and the yen total came out as `¥14,118.50` instead of `¥14,118`.

I changed `.lower()` to `.upper()`, so lowercase codes like `"jpy"` still work. I didn't touch any test files.
